# VRBody

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Unity's VRPlayer: the body follows the head in the room, the view axis turns the play area, poses are held without focus.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `yaw` | `float` | of the play area, rad |
| `turn_speed` | `float` | rad/s at full deflection (pi) |
| `standing_height` | `float` | legs height when the head is 1.8 m over the stage floor (1.8) |
| `hands` | `entt::entity[2]` | the hand entities |
| `head` | `glm::vec3` | written: the last trusted head position, stage space |
| `tracked` | `bool` | written: the head has been read once |
| `pose_hold` | `bool` | written: poses are held this frame |
| `was_focused` | `bool` | written: focus of the last frame |
| `seen_focus` | `bool` | written: focus has been seen once |
| `refocus_frame` | `int` | written: 0 not re-basing; 1, 2, 3 frames since the focus came back |

## Notes

Needs PlayerLegs, an input component, PlayerView and VRTracking. rotation() = yaw about Y.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Grab, PlayerViewpoint, VRHands, VRPlayerInput. Written by: PlayerSpawn, VRBody. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Grab](../systems/Grab.md) | system | Host | **read** | release | play area rotation: the controller's velocity in world space for a throw |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeVRPlayer) | play area yaw = spawn yaw, head at 1.8 m, its two hand entities |
| [PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | play area yaw and the last head position |
| [VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | focus state machine (pose_hold, was_focused, seen_focus, refocus_frame), last head position, tracked, yaw turned by the view axis |
| [VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md) | system | Host | **read** | step | of the hand's player: pose_hold, head, play area rotation |
| [VRPlayerInput](../systems/VRPlayerInput.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | view filter: only VR players |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
- **[VRPlayerInput](../systems/VRPlayerInput.md)**
  - None beyond the components (keeps its own play time, summed dt, for `last_action`).
